one_liner: MrScraper has a REST scraping API with self-serve API tokens, a free tier, and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: The REST API uses an API token sent in the x-api-token header. Marketplace endpoints take the same token as a Bearer token. OAuth 2.1 exists only on the hosted MCP server, not on the REST API, so it is not listed as an API auth method.
access_notes: The free plan needs no credit card and includes API tokens. Sources disagree on the free allocation: 1,000 tokens per month in one place, 100 tokens in the billing docs. Tokens are created in the dashboard.
blocker_notes: None. The breadth rating is a judgement because the evidence does not give an endpoint count.

evidence.quote: Include your API token in the `x-api-token` HTTP header on every request
API tokens are managed directly from your MrScraper dashboard.
Scraper Free includes 1,000 MrScraper tokens every month at no cost - no credit card required.
Sign in to the dashboard, open your account settings, and copy the token from the API Token page.
The MrScraper API uses API token authentication to secure all endpoints.
Every REST endpoint takes a MrScraper API token in the x-api-token header; Marketplace endpoints take the same token as an RFC 6750 Bearer
MrScraper MCP is the official [MrScraper](https://mrscraper.com) server for the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io).
